settings.heading: Design it
settings.text: Pick a setting, a stone shape and a metal in the studio above, or send us a reference and we will draw it with you.

settings.heading: See it before it exists
settings.text: We come back with a 3D view and a firm price. Change the stone, the band, the setting height — as many times as you need — until it is right.
settings.image_alt: A 3D view of a made-to-order ring

settings.heading: We make it
settings.text: Your piece is cast, set and finished by hand, then checked and sent to you insured. We will confirm the date with your quote.
settings.image_alt: A jeweller finishing a ring at the bench

settings.question: What does a bespoke piece cost?
settings.answer: The studio prices every change as you make it, so you always see the number before you commit. For a design that starts from scratch we quote once we have the drawing — the stone, the metal and the work involved set the price.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Making begins once you approve the design and the quote. We confirm the date in writing with your quote, so you know before you pay.

settings.question: Can I change the design after I have seen it?
settings.answer: Yes. Nothing is cut or cast until you have approved the 3D view, and changes before that point cost nothing.

settings.question: Can you use my own stone?
settings.answer: Often, yes — an heirloom diamond or a stone from a piece you no longer wear can be reset. Send us a photo and any certificate you have and we will tell you what is possible.

settings.question: Is it only rings?
settings.answer: No. Engagement rings and wedding bands are the most common, but we make necklaces, earrings and bracelets to order as well.

settings.heading: Design your own
settings.intro: Start from one of our settings or from a sketch of your own. Build the piece in 3D, watch the price move as you change it, and we will make it for you.
